show.description: After enduring five years of emotional abuse and neglect while posing as a lowly delivery boy to save his marriage, a secret billionaire finally exposes his unfaithful wife and her toxic family. Faced with his meteoric rise to power and the truth behind their "contract marriage," the wife struggles with regret as she realizes she traded a devoted man for a hollow opportunist.
